features: A completely new look — one violet design across every screen, in light and dark.
Clips now show what they are at a glance: text, link, code or image, and which device sent them.
The newest clip stands out, with a longer preview.
improvements: Background sync setup is now a numbered sequence that shows how far you have got.
Fonts ship inside the app, so it no longer downloads them on first launch.
fixes: Background sync now asks for the battery permission it actually needs. Without it, Android paused syncing minutes after the screen locked.
Copies now sync in the background on Pixel and other stock Android phones. Only Samsung's copy signal was detected before.
The permission help sheet no longer overflows on a short screen.
Button and chip outlines are now dark enough to see.
